mapper.sql: id, article_id, user_id, parent_id, content, likes, create_time
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.article_id, c.user_id, c.parent_id, CONCAT( CASE WHEN ru.user_name IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('@', ru.user_name, ' ') ELSE '' END, c.content ) AS content, c.likes, c.create_time, u.user_name, u.avatar FROM t_comment c LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON c.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN sys_user ru ON c.reply_target_id = ru.id WHERE c.article_id = #{articleId} and c.status = 1 ORDER BY c.create_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_comment_like WHERE comment_id = #{commentId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO t_comment_like (comment_id, user_id) VALUES (#{commentId}, #{userId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM t_comment_like WHERE comment_id = #{commentId} AND user_id = #{userId}
